scope: Records a field-level readiness demotion for the v2 sublabel `flavin.dehydrogenase_oxidase_hydride_transfer`. Does not rewrite the original audit artifact, edit any registry, change thresholds, alter production scoring, or import any labels. The original audit remains byte-stable and SHA-referenceable.
headline: Move `flavin.dehydrogenase_oxidase_hydride_transfer` from `ready_candidates` to `expert_review_needed_candidates`. Sublabel currently lumps clean hydride-transfer chemistry with semiquinone/electron-transfer, covalent FAD-adduct, flavin radical dehydratase, and already-relabeled NO reductase chemistries.

reason.summary: Population scan of the 50 flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase rows shows the proposed sublabel groups at least four mechanism classes that are not equivalent under hydride-transfer semantics. Promoting it to ready status would invite a stratified evaluation cell whose internal members do not share the named mechanism.

interim_eval_design_recommendation.description: Keep a single broad `flavin.dehydrogenase_oxidase_hydride_transfer` proposal-only stratum for statistical power, but add diagnostic axes when reporting per-row results.
diagnostic_axes_to_report_alongside_the_: mechanism_class: clean_hydride_transfer | electron_transfer_coupled | covalent_fad_adduct | flavin_radical_dehydratase | boundary_or_unresolved
interim_eval_design_recommendation.rationale: Statistically cheap, surfaces whether learned representations are recognising cofactor signatures versus FAD active-site mechanism.

downstream_consumers_to_update: Any future eval-design artifact that draws from `readiness_summary.ready_candidates` should also read this addendum and exclude `flavin.dehydrogenase_oxidase_hydride_transfer` until expert review resolves the in-bucket heterogeneity.
